scene: The brass tea robot pours sparkling blue jasmine into your ceramic cup.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view of the tea stall counter on a cobbled street. Far left, a rack of jars. Left of centre, the broad-shouldered Pacific Islander man in a floral shirt holds his ukulele. Centre, a round brass teapot automaton pours into a steaming blue cup. Far right sits an empty wooden cargo cart.
